payload.title: LIQ_SWEEP: BUY+D1-trend filter vs bidirectional recipe vs regime-matched controls
payload.question: After Phase 7.29 showed IS expectancy was ~93% BUY inside a gold bull and OOS failed via SELL mix-shift, does a BUY-only LIQ_SWEEP gated by D1 close > SMA200 beat regime-matched random long entries in the same bull cells, after costs, or is the apparent edge pure habitat?

A_BASELINE_BIDIRECTIONAL.definition: Current LIQ_SWEEP recipe as executed in Phase 7.23 isolation harness (BUY+SELL).

B_BUY_TREND_FILTER.definition: Same LIQ_SWEEP entries restricted to side=BUY AND causal D1 trend filter: at signal bar, prior D1 close > SMA(200) of D1 closes ending at that prior close (no future bars).

C_REGIME_MATCHED_RANDOM_LONG.definition: For each retained B event, one random D1 entry in the same regime cell (trend bucket x ATR tercile, trailing/causal) that is NOT the event bar; same forward outcome construction as B.

payload.primary_outcome: mean net R per closed trade (recipe SL/TP as in harness; costs: Dukascopy/spread stress profiles already used in Phase 7.25 when available, else report gross R and note)
secondary_outcomes: block bootstrap CI95 on mean R (month blocks)
cost stress delta if profiles available

decision_rule_frozen.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: n_B < 30 OR power gate NOT_ASSESSABLE/not POWER_READY for 0.3R target
decision_rule_frozen.HABITAT_ONLY: n_B>=30 AND (mean_R_B - mean_R_C) CI95 includes <=0 after costs
decision_rule_frozen.SIGNAL_SUPPORTED_AS_HYPOTHESIS: n_B>=30 AND (mean_R_B - mean_R_C) CI95 lower bound > 0 after base costs AND survives one declared cost-stress profile; still NOT live-ready
decision_rule_frozen.MIXED: any other non-insufficient pattern; no promotion

exploratory_replay_allowed_on: phase7_23 LIQ_SWEEP diagnostic trades (2023-10-02..2026-06-30) — EXPOSED / DISCOVERY_REUSE
phase7_9h D1 gold CSV for SMA200 / regime labels — EXPOSED
data_policy.exploratory_replay_status: NOT_PROMOTABLE — any result on exposed windows is DISCOVERY_REUSE / CONTAMINATED for confirmation
data_policy.confirmatory_requires: New forward MT5 isolation run after 2026-09-27 OR a genuinely untouched dataset per phase7_26 exposure registry; prereg commit must precede that run (engine/preregistration_provenance_guard.py).

payload.power_note: Edge Detection Capability V1: LIQ-like σ~1.44R needs ~180 trades for 0.3R at 80% power. IS BUY n≈39 is EXPLORATORY_ONLY for confirmatory claims. Power Gate V1 currently returns NOT_ASSESSABLE for production plans (level calibration not preregistered) — this experiment does not claim POWER_READY.
